why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: 1 Step 1 : Open the Velvet app Go to VelvetX , which the Velvet docs call its flagship trading app. The Epoch 12 post says the Velvet app shows Gems rewards, your ranking and your progress, without naming which app.

2 Step 2 : Connect or create a wallet Link a wallet you already use (MetaMask and Phantom are both named) or set up a fresh non-custodial one with an email or social login, then add the funds you plan to trade.
3 Step 3 : Trade spot or perps Trade on the terminal, since trading is one of the main ways to earn Gems. Gems follow the fees you pay on your trades.
4 Step 4 : Claim your Gems every day Return on consecutive days to claim Gems and build the streak bonus. You can also stake VELVET or invite active traders to raise your Gems.
5 Step 5 : Check your rank for the next airdrop Follow your position on the Gems leaderboard in the app, and read the Epoch 13 announcement on the Velvet blog for the current epoch.
